storyline_body_0: The Miami afternoon was a Mahomes accuracy tape, not a smash-mouth one. Kenneth Walker III still took 20 touches (18 rushes, 2 catches) and ran in the 10-yard score at Q1 12:54, but the line did not move Miami the way a 3-0 club wants to move a defense heading into a West game. Emmett Johnson added 6 rushes. The rest of the 88 yards were scraps. When the Chiefs needed a yard at the Miami 12, H. Nourzad reported eligible and Walker was stuffed. That is the snap Las Vegas will circle.
